profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | SaaS | Payments | Node.js | .NET | API & Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff-level Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable systems, payment platforms, and SaaS products from the ground up.

Most of my career has been focused on backend and platform engineering—designing APIs, integrating payment systems, and modernizing legacy architectures into scalable, cloud-ready solutions. I’ve led work that spans multiple products, helping unify systems, improve developer workflows, and drive reliable production delivery.

Recently, I’ve been building SaaS platforms end-to-end:

* **JobProof** — a field-service platform for job tracking, documentation, invoicing, and payments
* **Fundaloop** — a financial platform for group-based contributions and scheduled payouts

These projects reflect how I like to work: owning systems from architecture to production, focusing on clean design, type safety, and long-term scalability.

Technically, I spend most of my time in:

* Node.js / TypeScript / NestJS
* PostgreSQL / Prisma
* .NET (legacy + modern systems)
* AWS and CI/CD pipelines

I also actively use AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering standards.

What I bring:

* Strong system design and platform thinking
* Deep experience in payments and API architecture
* Ability to modernize legacy systems without disrupting business
* Mentorship and engineering leadership

I’m especially interested in:

* Staff / Lead Engineering roles
* Backend or platform-heavy systems
* SaaS and fintech products
* Early-stage or scaling teams

If you’re building something interesting in those spaces, I’d love to connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Founder
positions.description:
- Architected a financial SaaS platform for group-based contributions and scheduled payouts

- Designed multi-tenant system supporting group ownership, member roles, and subscription-based access

- Led system design for payment integrations with focus on fund flow safety, compliance considerations, and provider abstraction

- Defined product architecture, MVP scope, and long-term scalability strategy

- Built backend services using Node.js and PostgreSQL with focus on modularity and maintainability

- Established CI/CD workflows and deployed infrastructure using Railway

- Designed platform for extensibility including messaging integrations, subscriptions, and mobile expansion
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · TypeScript · Prisma ORM · Systems Design · SASS · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Led architecture and development of a centralized Payment API integrating Stripe, Global Payments, and Ezidebit

- Drove adoption of the Payment API across multiple products, enabling a unified payment processing platform

- Architected and built a Global API (Node.js, MySQL) to unify legacy and modern systems

- Designed and implemented event-driven processing using AWS SQS and .NET Core services

- Improved CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, increasing deployment reliability and developer velocity

- Mentored engineers and contributed to engineering standards and modernization initiatives

- Contributed to development of a unified mobile platform (POR ONE)

- Led adoption of modern frameworks including ASP.NET Web API, Angular, and Ionic
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · TypeScript · Systems Design · SASS · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led migration of legacy systems and CI/CD pipelines to Team Foundation Server (TFS)

- Designed and deployed enterprise applications using .NET technologies and SQL Server

- Managed IIS configurations and production deployments

- Facilitated technical design discussions across business and engineering teams

- Delivered high-quality solutions and mentored junior developers
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Systems Design · SASS · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Software Engineer / Offshore Dev Lead
positions.description:
- Developed and supported enterprise systems using .NET and SQL Server

- Served as Subject Matter Expert for claims processing platform (ACCS)

- Led offshore development efforts and collaborated with onshore teams

- Performed system design, impact analysis, and production support

- Mentored developers and supported testing and release cycles
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Systems Design · SASS · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
- Supported enhancement and optimization of database components to improve data accuracy and system reliability

- Managed data ingestion and population workflows for survey datasets into application repositories

- Improved user interface and navigation flows, enhancing usability of existing web applications

- Debugged and strengthened validation logic and user controls to improve data integrity and user experience

- Processed and transformed raw datasets into aggregated reports and analytical outputs for business insights

- Contributed to middleware data transformation templates to normalize diverse data into application schema

- Integrated user administration module to support role-based access and system management

- Provided user training and documentation to support system adoption
